user.title: Set up Passable Smart Chores Engine
user.description: Configure your daily reset schedule, weekly rollover, trust mode, and optional school holiday calendars. Kids, chores, rewards, and screen time unlocks can all be managed right from the Passable Chores Card.

data_description.daily_reset_time: Local time when daily chores reset and screen time unlocks re-lock for the new day (default 05:00).
data_description.weekly_reset_day: Day of week when flexible weekly chores reset and rotating chores shift to the next child (default Monday).
data_description.weekly_due_day: Day when unfinished flexible weekly chores become required today and gate weekend device unlocks (default Saturday).
data_description.default_trust_mode: Choose between instant Honor System check-offs or Parent Approval required before unlocking devices.
data_description.no_school_calendars: Optional calendar entities (e.g. calendar.academic, calendar.holidays_in_united_states) that automatically treat school-day breaks as weekends.
data_description.gamification_enabled: Show star points, daily streaks, and the rewards shop (can be toggled anytime).
data_description.seed_starter_templates: Pre-populate common household chore and reward templates that you can customize or delete later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Passable Smart Chores Engine is supported.

init.title: Passable Smart Chores Engine Settings
init.description: Update global chore reset schedules, default trust mode, holiday calendars, and gamification preferences.

data_description.daily_reset_time: Local 24h time when daily chores reset (e.g. 05:00).
data_description.weekly_reset_day: Day of week when weekly chores reset and rotating chores advance.
data_description.weekly_due_day: Day of week when unfinished flexible weekly chores become required today.
data_description.default_trust_mode: Global default between Honor System and Parent Approval (overridable per kid or chore).
data_description.no_school_calendars: Calendar entities checked for school holidays and breaks.
data_description.gamification_enabled: Enable or hide star points, streaks, and rewards.
